rationale: The originally targeted 1302-slice CC-CCII pulmonary-lesion annotation resource has not been reproduced from the mounted/public sources.
A separately documented public CC-CCII/NCP lesion segmentation resource contains 750 CT slices from 150 COVID-19 patients with background, lung field, GGO and consolidation masks.
Pleural-effusion segmentation remains locked because it is not part of the reproducible 750-slice public resource.

external_resources_preserved.note: Neither external resource may be repurposed for training or threshold selection.

split_rule.preferred: use stable patient/scan identifiers distributed with the public resource
split_rule.fallback: if stable grouping exists but no official split is distributed, freeze deterministic patient/scan-level 80/10/10 split with seed 1705 before training

next_gate: Acquire or mount the public 750-slice NCP resource.
Verify image-mask pairing, label values, stable patient/scan grouping, exact counts and hashes.
Only after verification freeze Step11 subtype split and training config.
